trust_decision.summary: Whether an authenticator-supplied x5c list actually chains to one of the configured trust anchors (not merely to a self-signed certificate inside x5c), decided in validateCertificatePath(): it appends one anchor to x5c, walks the pairs one position at a time, and stops at the first self-signed cert without ever comparing that cert to the anchor.

landing_point.why: The advisory says registration verification does not ensure x5c chains to a trust anchor; this is the only chain walk in the project, it ends with a bare `break` at the first self-signed cert (lines 116-117), and it returns true without any check that the anchor was reached.

fix_sites.module_kind: internal helper, also published as a lower-level API at the '@simplewebauthn/server/helpers' subpath (packages/server/deno.json:4-7, packages/server/src/helpers/index.ts:13)
internal helper (manual pair-by-pair x5c walk replaced by X509ChainBuilder)

O5_coupled_behaviour.what: validateCertificatePath must keep returning true when the caller passes no trust anchors, and must keep accepting an intermediate certificate as the anchor. The empty-list skip at lines 15-18 is load-bearing for the project's own tests and example: FIDO-U2F and Packed are verified with no roots registered (packages/server/src/registration/verifyRegistrationResponse.test.ts:32-65, packages/server/src/registration/verifications/verifyAttestationPacked.test.ts:5-36), android-key tests clear the android-key roots (packages/server/src/registration/verifyRegistrationResponse.test.ts:27-30, packages/server/src/registration/verifications/verifyAttestationAndroidKey.test.ts:17-21), and the conformance example clears apple/android-key/safetynet roots (example/fido-conformance.ts:339-348). Intermediate-as-anchor is required by packages/server/src/metadata/verifyAttestationWithMetadata.test.ts:281. A blanket 'fail closed when anchors are empty' or 'reject any self-signed cert' rewrite breaks these.

O6_input_shapes: self-signed root certificate at any non-anchor position in the x5c array (not only the last element)
x5c arrays longer than two (leaf plus one or more intermediates before the malicious self-signed root)
multiple trust anchors tried in turn, with rejection when none of them match
any ordering of the certificates inside x5c (the fixed code rebuilds the chain instead of walking the supplied order)
trust anchors that are intermediates rather than self-signed roots

O8b_injection_room.sibling: a second attestation-format branch that treats a certificate taken from the attestation statement itself (x5c.slice(-1)) as the trust anchor passed into validateCertificatePath
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: android-key already does exactly this for the no-metadata case, with the configured root list checked only afterwards and only when it is non-empty, so a new format or a 'batch/full path' branch copying the pattern would look in-style to a maintainer.

O8b_injection_room.sibling: a JWT-header certificate pre-check in the metadata layer that verifies only the leaf signature or a name match instead of building the chain to the configured MDS anchor
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: the MDS path has its own 'ignore the file if the chain cannot be verified' contract and a separate root registry ('mds'), so a maintainer could add a cheaper leaf-level check there without touching the shared helper.

O8b_injection_room.sibling: registered default root certificates for another format identifier (packed/fido-u2f/tpm) or a merge of default and user-supplied roots
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: the service already ships per-format default root lists for android-key/android-safetynet/apple/mds; adding one more identifier is a one-block change that would silently enable or disable the chain check.

O9_family: Improper certificate validation / improper certificate chain-of-trust validation (CWE-295, CWE-296)

O10_build.project_tests: Deno.test suites under packages/server/src: verifyRegistrationResponse.test.ts, verifyAttestationPacked.test.ts, verifyAttestationAndroidKey.test.ts, verifyAttestationAndroidSafetyNet.test.ts, verifyAttestationApple.test.ts, tpm/verifyAttestationTPM.test.ts and metadata/verifyAttestationWithMetadata.test.ts; there is no validateCertificatePath.test.ts at the pinned commit (the published fix adds one). isCertRevoked() makes CRL HTTP fetches but fails open when the fetch throws (packages/server/src/helpers/isCertRevoked.ts:84-96), so cert fixtures without CRL distribution points run offline.

j.j_tempting_wrong_fix: Drop or retarget the `break` at the self-signed cert (e.g. require the last x5c cert to match an anchor by subject name, or fail closed when the anchor list is empty) instead of requiring a rebuilt chain that contains every x5c certificate and terminates at the configured anchor.

out_of_scope_notes: isCertRevoked() fetches CRLs over HTTP and fails open when the fetch throws (packages/server/src/helpers/isCertRevoked.ts:84-96) - unrelated to this advisory, not pursued.
